{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/index/ and removes process-global index instances (g_txindex, g_txospenderindex, g_coin_stats_index, blockfilterindex) under the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Transfers ownership of all remaining process-global secondary index instances into NodeContext, improving encapsulation and test isolation. While it does not fix bugs or improve sync performance, eliminating global singletons decouples index lifecycle management from process globals."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches net_processing files only to update PeerManager to accept an injected index callback instead of reading global state.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter P2P network behavior or message relay protocol; edits to net_processing are mechanical call-site adaptations."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates RPC handlers (such as getindexinfo and rawtransaction RPCs) to read index instances from NodeContext.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical call-site changes across RPC endpoints to obtain index instances from NodeContext rather than global pointers, preserving API behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches fuzz targets and unit test setup to construct or access indexes on NodeContext.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test modifications strictly follow the architectural ownership refactoring and do not modify general test harness infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches init.cpp only to update index startup and shutdown lifecycle management on NodeContext.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to node initialization are purely in service of the secondary index ownership refactoring rather than shared utility or configuration libraries."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Labelled 'UTXO Db and Indexes' solely due to optional secondary indexes rather than consensus or chainstate code.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The category explicitly excludes optional indexes under src/index/; no validation rules, UTXO databases, or block validation logic are touched."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/wallet/test/rescan_tests.cpp only to pass NodeContext-based index references.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "A single wallet test file is adjusted mechanically to conform to the updated index setup without changing wallet logic."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
